text: Reviewed 9c6dbbe82 (#5426, launcher artifact inventory atomic read): no findings. The migration preserves the existing rejection/error paths while binding SHA256 input bytes to the exact object opened by the containment walk. I traced all launcher_artifacts consumers and confirmed this call site has no single-link invariant or downstream link_count dependency, so using the handle reader content_equal() policy does not weaken its contract. Documentation/traceability claims match the code. Fresh local validation: cmake --build build --target test_security_controls -j2 && ./build/tests/test_security_controls — All tests passed; cmake --build build --target test_runtime_pipeline -j2 && ./build/tests/test_runtime_pipeline — All tests passed. Note the launcher/security source is compiled into test_runtime_pipeline; there is no standalone target named test_runtime_pipeline_launcher_and_security.
